title: Adaptive HLS Source-Aware Ladder Runtime
problem: Nako's adaptive HLS fMP4 runtime is executable, but it still uses a fixed two-rendition ladder and assumes every adaptive variant has audio.

evidence.summary: Opened the durable fearless refactor lane for source-aware adaptive HLS ladder policy and no-audio adaptive FFmpeg stream-map planning.
Added source-aware adaptive ladder planning, carried client max width and height into transcode constraints, and bound concrete ladder plans into request-variant identity.
Made adaptive FFmpeg HLS command planning emit audio-bearing or video-only maps, encoders, and var_stream_map entries based on selected source audio presence.
Integrated adaptive ladder plans into server HLS staging, playback runtime request identity, artifact manifest reconstruction, and focused playback coverage.
Verified focused gates, recorded evidence, closed the workstream, and left broader adaptive features as follow-ons.

continue_policy.notes: The lane is closed. Follow-on work should open a new workstream for adaptive MPEG-TS, alternate audio/subtitle renditions, LL-HLS/CMAF/DRM, or a second transcode engine adapter.
